Resource Profile: Medicinal Product Definition

Official URL: https://www.ages.at/fhir/medicinalproduct/StructureDefinition/at-medprod-medicinalproductdefinition Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2025-07-01 Computable Name: AT_MedicinalProduct_MedicinalProductDefinition

Medicinal Product Definition profiled resource containing a subset of attributes needed for the Austrian eHealth Community

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: Administrable product definition, Marketing Regulated Authorization and Packaged product definition
